verdict.rationale: Square's Payments API 'take payments' docs list ACH bank transfer, Afterpay/Clearpay (BNPL) and Cash App Pay (a wallet) alongside card payments, and the Web Payments SDK supports a single integration, so part of the story is evidenced. The pack never mentions Apple Pay or Google Pay, and ACH is a bank transfer rather than a bank-redirect method. Missing for 10: explicit Apple Pay and Google Pay support, bank-redirect or local payment methods beyond ACH, detail showing all methods run through one integration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
